name: get_recent_conversations
description: Get recent conversation history in chronological order. ALWAYS use this tool for temporal queries like: 'what was the last conversation?', 'what did I just ask?', 'what was my last question?', 'show recent history', 'what did we just talk about?', 'what was my previous request?'. This tool does NOT require a query parameter - it returns conversations by TIME. Use 'search_conversations' only if user asks to SEARCH for a specific TOPIC from past conversations.

limit.description: Maximum number of conversations to return (default: 10)

session_id.description: Optional: filter by specific session ID to get conversations only from that session
